name: Assemble Text
description: A GSAP text animation where characters arrive one by one in random order and the paragraph reflows into place as it fills in. No layout shift: the block holds its final size from the start.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to assemble. Plain text; line breaks come from the container's width.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds until every character is in.

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' starts when the text scrolls into view (once); 'mount' starts right away.

props.name: start
props.description: When 'view' starts, as a ScrollTrigger start.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, if the text sits inside its own scroll container.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the text element: font, size, colour, width.
